parameters.query:
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='trading' AND table_name IN ('paper_trades','paper_trade_events','paper_trade_valuations','paper_trade_costs')) AS ap1_tabellen_erwartet_4,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='trading' AND table_name='paper_trades' AND column_name IN ('gross_pnl','net_pnl','realized_r_multiple','maximum_favorable_excursion','maximum_adverse_excursion','ambiguous_execution')) AS ap4_spalten_erwartet_6,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='trading' AND table_name IN ('portfolio_risk_checks','stress_scenarios','strategy_status','strategy_parameters')) AS ap5_ap6_ap9_tabellen_erwartet_4,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trading.pipeline_config WHERE config_key IN ('MAX_TOTAL_OPEN_RISK_PCT','MAX_SECTOR_EXPOSURE_PCT','MAX_SINGLE_POSITION_PCT','MAX_OPEN_POSITIONS','MAX_DIRECTIONAL_EXPOSURE_PCT','MAX_PORTFOLIO_DRAWDOWN_PCT','CORRELATION_LOOKBACK_DAYS','MAX_PAIRWISE_CORRELATION','STRESS_RISK_REDUCTION_FACTOR')) AS ap5_config_erwartet_9,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trading.strategy_status) AS ap9_status_zeilen_erwartet_4,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trading.strategy_parameters) AS ap9_parameter_zeilen_erwartet_10,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='trading' AND table_name IN ('backtest_runs','backtest_trades','probability_estimates','calibration_checks')) AS ap7_ap8_tabellen_erwartet_4,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trading.pipeline_config WHERE config_key IN ('PROBABILITY_MIN_SAMPLE_SIZE','LEARNING_MIN_TRADE_SAMPLE_SIZE','BACKTEST_MIN_WINDOW_DAYS')) AS ap7_ap8_config_erwartet_3;
